author: GitHub
description:
Many developers start using AI for basic code completion or chat, but get stuck when trying to scale its impact across their engineering team. In this video, GitHub experts explain how to move from treating AI as a toy to integrating it as a core workflow tool. Learn how one internal GitHub team automated their documentation lifecycle using an agentic workflow.

GitHub's Agentic Engineering System: http://gh.io/aes-framework 
Automating cross-repo documentation with GitHub Agentic Workflows: https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/github-copilot/automating-cross-repo-documentation-with-github-agentic-workflows/
